location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company
stakeIfLost: If the chest is not returned, Hosmunt cannot unlock the mill's toll apparatus kept inside and the mill will be forced to close, costing him his season's trade.
arrival: sent word twice before coming · said the whole of it standing
OPPOSES: falconer · seize the chest for himself rather than hand it to the miller
clientTell: rubs a thumb along a scar without noticing

cast.name: Hosmunt Hollis
cast.who: miller on the western road who sent a cart through the charcoal-burners' camps and lost a brass-bound chest to his millpond
cast.want: to have the brass-bound chest returned to him

bible.goal: To recover the brass-bound chest lost in the millpond and return it to its owner.

relevantLore.name: Grindle Millpond
relevantLore.blurb: A small, still pond fed by the mill run and ringed by willows.

arcStep: Question the charcoal-burners at the Kilnstead Camps about the pond and search the shoreline
